text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ooh~ I'm really looking forward to the upcoming Sports Day fan event! Is your family coming, Pokke?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, my big bro and little sis! And get this!
My sis made a flag to cheer me on~!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She sent me a pic, and it's crazy cool!
Man, I gotta bust loose even harder than usual!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I see.
'The effect of blood relatives' presence on running performance,' is it?

text_block_list.name: Young Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Hmph... Whenever Mother and the others are around, I feel like I can run faster than usual.
...Why? What is the rationale?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
—Very well, I shall take this opportunity to verify it!
In which case, I must summon my own parents as well.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Seriously? YOU are???

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the day of the Sports Day... Tracen Academy was bustling with countless fans and students' families.

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Father
text_block_list.text:
...You never tire of this, do you, Tachyon?
What experiment are you conducting today?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Regarding 'the effect of blood relatives' presence on running performance.'
I'm counting on you today, Father, Mother.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: T-They actually came...?! Tachyon's parents are way too forgiving!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hawawa... My oshi's family right before my eyes...! Wait, does this mean I get to witness precious family lore...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, amidst the mingling crowd of fans and diverse families, the Sports Day commenced.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "Now then! The pairs conquer the obstacle course race! Currently in the lead is the Jungle Pocket pair!"

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Big bro—! Big sis—!
Do your best—!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Hah! Hey, bro, hop on my back!
—Let's gooooo, oraaaaaaa!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This is the real thing!
This savory aroma, this juicy meatiness! A burger's gotta be like this, no doubt!

text_block_list.name: Digital's Father
text_block_list.text:
You've got that right!
My wife's burgers are number one in the world! Eat up, eat plenty!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: ...? My oshi and my father are talking...? My oshi and hamburgers...? Is this a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there, zero conversation...?
What a wild family...

text_block_list.name: Sports Day Staff
text_block_list.text: "Calling all participants. Horse girls and guardians taking part in the Parent-Child Relay, please proceed to the staging tent."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let us go then, Mother. Father, please cheer loudly as instructed.

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Father
text_block_list.text: ...Right. Make sure you don't get injured.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "Here it comes! The baton is passed to the next runner! Currently leading is Agnes Tachyon's mother, herself a former horse girl who won the Oka Sho!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! How long has it been since I last saw Mother run with all her might?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...This is surprisingly exhilarating.

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Parents
text_block_list.text:
—Tachyon! I'm trusting this to you!
—Go! Run, Tachyon!

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: "Look at that! A magnificent baton pass! The baton goes from mother to daughter!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
"What speed...! Agnes Tachyon is fast! Agnes Tachyon is so fast!
Living up to her namesake, she leaves the trailing pack in the dust!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: (Indeed, a part distinct from either brain or heart is resonating with the voices of my father and mother. My physical performance seems to improve proportionally, yet...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: (This sensation... I have felt it somewhere before...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: —Aha.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
AHAHAHA!
...Fascinating! Truly fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Forgive me right after returning, but I must head back to the laboratory.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I will call you later for a debriefing, so be sure to answer. Farewell for now♪

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey!
...Are you serious, girl?!

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Never changing, as always.

text_block_list.name: Tachyon's Father
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! No sleep for me tonight~!
